components: A versioned graph defines steps, dependencies, timers, and compensation.
The engine durably records the current instance and completed steps.
A worker executes one idempotent activity and reports its result.
The engine advances newly eligible steps or schedules retries.
The workflow completes, fails, or runs compensation with an auditable history.
